checks.name: initial
checks.coverage: All 256 eight-input sequences from reset, both state transitions and holds, reset priority for both inputs, reset held across clocks, and reset pulse without a rising clock; 6943 output checks.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
The specification does not define the state before the first synchronous reset; the testbench makes no output assertion before that reset.
implementation: One-bit Moore state register with B=1, A=0, active-high synchronous reset to B, toggle on input zero and hold on input one.
